steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the combo or disconnect power before servicing. Discharge PBA terminals per manual.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Make sure to disconnect the power plug before servicing.

steps.title: Inspect sub/main harness
steps.body: AC: verify wire connections between sub and main PBAs. Check for moisture on sub PBA.
steps.sourceExcerpt: AC: verify wire connections between sub and main PBAs. Check for moisture on sub PBA.

steps.title: Module-specific comm fault
steps.body: AC3 DR module, AC4 Wi-Fi, AC5 LCD, or AC6 inverter? Inspect that module harness.
steps.sourceExcerpt: AC3 DR module, AC4 Wi-Fi, AC5 LCD, or AC6 inverter? Inspect that module harness.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Repair harness or replace affected module/PBA.

steps.title: Comm restored after power cycle?
steps.body: After reconnecting harnesses and power cycle, does combo run without AC codes?
steps.sourceExcerpt: After reconnecting harnesses and power cycle, does combo run without AC codes?

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Replace main or inverter PBA per fault code.

steps.title: Repair harness/module
steps.oemOutcome: Correct loose connections or replace comm module.

steps.title: Replace PBA
steps.oemOutcome: Replace main or inverter PBA per fault code.
